nav.resetConfirm: Reset all demo data in every open tab?

gate.title: {{role}} demo login
gate.noSignup: No sign-up needed. This is a demo.
gate.serverNote: The data lives on the PharmaFlow server and is shared with every device at once.
gate.customer: Buy medicines, grab Eco-Sale deals, donate leftovers and dispose of expired strips safely.
gate.chemist: Your free ERP: scan stock, watch expiry buckets and rescue near-expiry medicines.
gate.rider: Deliver orders and collect donations and Yellow-Bag pickups.
gate.admin: Approve pharmacies, track impact and verify the audit ledger.
gate.dealer: Quote on pooled bulk orders from medical stores and deliver the ones you win.

shop.askJanAushadhi: ask for it at a Jan Aushadhi Kendra
shop.ecoBatch: Eco-Sale batch available at {{pct}}% off. See the Deals tab.

deals.empty: No Eco-Sale stock right now. When a chemist puts a near-expiry batch on sale, it appears here instantly.
deals.intro: Near-expiry stock at 40–60% off. Prescription rules still apply. Or sponsor a batch: {{amount}} puts packs into an NGO's hands.
deals.expires: Expires in {{days}} days • fits a {{course}}-day course • {{qty}} left

sponsor.topsUp: {{amount}} tops up the NGO fund. It can only buy medicines for NGOs, never cash.
sponsor.reward: Once the NGO has the packs you earn +{{karma}} karma, a scratch card and an NGO Donor certificate. If the pharmacist's check fails, you get {{amount}} back as MedWallet credit.
sponsor.done: Sponsored. A rider will collect the packs from the pharmacy for the NGO.

cart.empty: Your cart is empty. Add medicines from the Shop or Deals tab.
cart.noPharmacy: No approved pharmacy is available yet
cart.payNote: Pay on delivery. MedWallet is store credit and can never be cashed out.
cart.placedRx: Order placed. The pharmacist will review your prescription.

orders.reason: Reason: {{reason}}. Upload a clearer or correct prescription.
orders.fundShare: {{amount}} from this order went into the NGO fund, which only buys medicines for NGOs.

track.riderComing: Your rider is on the way. Arriving in about {{min}} min.
track.riderAccepted: A rider has accepted your order and is heading to the pharmacy.
track.pins: Pins: {{pins}}. The moving dot is your rider (simulated).

scratch.aria: Scratch card. Drag to scratch, or use the Reveal button

civic.reminderBody: Donate the unopened {{what}} left to {{ngo}} and earn karma.
civic.donateBody: Sealed strips with more than 30 days left go to a verified NGO clinic after a pharmacist checks them. Pickup is free.
civic.coldChain: Cold-chain medicines such as insulin cannot be donated.
civic.pickupScheduled: Free pickup scheduled. A rider will collect it.
civic.chooseMedicine: Choose the medicine you want to donate
civic.enterBatch: Enter the batch number from the strip
civic.chooseNgoAndPharmacy: Choose an NGO and a pharmacy for the quality check
civic.disposeBody: Expired medicines are hazardous waste. Never bin or flush them: antibiotics that leak into water feed superbugs. A rider collects a sealed Yellow Bag and takes it to the authorised incineration plant.
civic.disposeChoose: Choose the medicine you want to dispose of
civic.bloodBody: Book an appointment at a blood bank near you. In India blood donation is voluntary and unpaid, so the thank-you is +500 karma, a certificate and a badge, never cash.
civic.booked: Appointment booked. Thank you for saving lives.

activity.noPickups: No pickups yet. Donate or dispose of medicines above and track them here.
activity.noSponsorships: Nothing sponsored yet. Open Deals and tap "Sponsor batch for NGO" to put packs into an NGO's hands.
activity.noCertificates: Complete a donation, a safe disposal or a blood donation to earn a certificate with a QR code.
activity.pdfFailed: Could not create the PDF. Please try again.

status.collectedDonation: Collected. The pharmacist is checking it
status.collectedDisposal: Collected. On the way to the CBWTF plant
status.rejected: Did not pass the check. Going for safe disposal
status.refunded: Did not pass the pharmacist's check. {{amount}} is back in your MedWallet

chemist.tagline: ₹0 licence · ₹0 add-ons · ₹0 AMC — saved ₹35,000/yr vs legacy ERPs
chemist.noOrders: No orders waiting. New customer orders appear here live.
chemist.packed: Packed. Riders can see the mission
chemist.rxRejectedToast: Prescription rejected. The customer can re-upload
chemist.noQa: Nothing to inspect. Donated strips arrive here after a rider collects them.
chemist.sponsoredNote: A customer paid for these packs. You are paid {{amount}} once the NGO has them; if you reject them the customer is refunded and you are not paid.
chemist.checkSeal: Check the seal, batch and expiry before releasing.
chemist.qaRejectedToast: Rejected. A rider will take it to the CBWTF
chemist.ecoLive: {{brand}} is live in the Eco-Sale store

alerts.title: Expiry alerts: within 6 months
alerts.intro: These batches expire within 6 months. Put them on Eco-Sale now so they sell before they are wasted.
alerts.none: No batch expires within the next 6 months. You will be alerted here when one does.
alerts.split: PharmaFlow fee {{fee}} · you receive {{store}} a pack
alerts.blocked: Too close to expiry to sell. Donate or dispose of it from the expiry ledger.

chemist.yellowBagScheduled: Yellow-Bag pickup scheduled for the CBWTF

sponsored.title: Sponsored for NGOs
sponsored.empty: When a customer sponsors a batch of yours for an NGO, it appears here. You hand the packs to the rider, check them at the QA desk, and are paid the Eco-Sale price once the NGO has them.

status.PLACED: Packs on the way to the NGO

writeOff.title: Write-off receipts
writeOff.empty: When a donation reaches an NGO or expired stock is incinerated, its receipt with the GST ITC reversal appears here as a PDF.

rider.backhaulBody: {{items}} at {{address}}. Collect it on this trip for +{{pay}}.
rider.waitingQa: Take it to the chemist. Waiting for the QA check.
rider.nothingNearby: Nothing nearby. New missions appear here live.

admin.bloodNoMoney: Blood rewards carry no money value
admin.noBookings: No bookings yet. Customers book from the Civic hub.
admin.confirmedToast: Donation confirmed: karma, certificate and badge awarded
admin.confirmNote: Confirming awards +500 karma, a certificate and a badge. Blood rewards never have money value.
admin.noEvents: No events yet. Actions in the other tabs appear here live.

fund.closedLoop: Closed-loop: it only buys medicines for NGOs, never paid out as cash.

bulk.noDeal: No deal: stopped at {{price}}, above the ceiling
bulk.savings: Saves {{amount}} against the usual trade price

chemist.title: Bulk orders with other stores
chemist.intro: Need a large quantity? Ask here. PharmaFlow pools your request with other stores, dealers quote on the total, and every store pays the same lower price.

next.COLLECTING: More stores can still join. The admin then asks dealers to quote.
next.NEGOTIATED: The agents have negotiated. The admin is choosing a dealer.
next.AWARDED: A dealer has won and is delivering your stock.
next.DELIVERED: Delivered. The stock is in your expiry ledger.

chemist.poolOpen_one: {{count}} store is already pooling {{qty}} packs of this item. Add yours.
chemist.poolOpen_other: {{count}} stores are already pooling {{qty}} packs of this item. Add yours.
chemist.inPool: Your store is in this pool. Change the quantity and update it any time before dealers are asked.

admin.title: Pooled bulk orders
admin.intro: Stores pool their requests. You set the price limits, dealers quote, the agents negotiate and you choose the winner.
admin.none: No bulk requests yet. A chemist starts one from the bulk orders section of the store dashboard.
admin.limitsHint: The buyer's agent opens at the target and never pays more than the ceiling.
admin.needStores: Needs at least {{n}} stores before dealers are asked.
admin.noQuotes: No quotes yet. Dealers quote from their own dashboard.
admin.effectiveHint: The effective price adds 0.5% for each delivery day and 2% for each rating star below five.
admin.nobody: No dealer came down to the ceiling. Cancel this order and start again with a higher ceiling.

dealer.none: No bulk orders are open right now. They appear here as soon as the admin asks for quotes.
dealer.floorHint: Only your own negotiating agent uses the lowest price. It never goes below it.
dealer.yourQuote: Your quote: {{ask}} a pack, lowest {{floor}}, delivery in {{days}} days
dealer.waitingNegotiation: Waiting for the admin to start the negotiation.
dealer.pending: The admin is choosing a dealer.
dealer.won: You won this order at {{price}} a pack.
dealer.deliveredDone: Delivered. Every store has its share.
